name: handoff
description: Plan in one AI. Build in another. Sends a prepared brief with original attachments to your other assistant.

interface.shortDescription: Hand work to another AI assistant with a brief and the original files.
interface.longDescription: Say "hand this off" and your assistant writes a brief (purpose, decisions and reasons, constraints, next step, references, open questions), attaches the files you choose, and stores it privately for you. In your other assistant say "continue my handoff" to read it and keep going. Same person, your own account, no transcript export.
